subject.title: feat: Tiered bootstrap file loading for progressive context control

question: Should OpenClaw add a new `agents.defaults.bootstrapTier` config contract for bootstrap file selection, or should maintainers steer users to existing `skipBootstrap`, `bootstrapMaxChars`, `bootstrapTotalMaxChars`, per-run lightweight context, and hook controls?
rationale: Root policy sets a high bar for new config keys, and the issue requests a new user-facing config surface that changes runtime context injection semantics across main, subagent, and cron sessions.

options.title: Review Tier Contract
options.body: Proceed with maintainer review of the linked implementation or a replacement that defines tier semantics, compatibility, docs, and tests.

options.title: Use Existing Knobs
options.body: Decline the new tier surface and document the existing lightweight/context-budget controls as the supported path.

recommendation.title: Review Tier Contract
recommendation.body: Proceed with maintainer review of the linked implementation or a replacement that defines tier semantics, compatibility, docs, and tests.
